title: Watercolor Christmas Clipart Bundle Vol.1
author: Charnelle's Canvas
description:
Watercolor Christmas Clipart Bundle Vol.1
Bring the magic of Christmas to your creative projects with this enchanting watercolor Christmas clipart bundle. This delightful collection features over 150 high-resolution images, including charming winter mugs, festive Christmas cupcakes, delicate fir branches adorned with pine cones and bows, cute Santa hats, cozy Christmas stockings, whimsical gnomes, and a delightful assortment of animal families such as penguins, polar bears, elephants, lamas, owls, capybaras, and more.
This versatile clipart bundle is perfect for a variety of creative print and digital projects, including:
🎄 Print on demand
🎄 Scrapbooking
🎄 Invitations & greeting cards
🎄 Social media graphics and much more!
Features
🎄 Over 150 high-resolution 300 DPI images
🎄 PNG & JPG format
🎄 Transparent backgrounds for easy layering
Get this great bundle for just $5 and save $138!
